newsitem.title: RUSSIA: EBRD buys Russian brewery stake.
newsitem.headline: EBRD buys Russian brewery stake.

text.p: The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) has bought a 33 percent stake in the AO Vyena brewery in St Petersburg, the plant's chief executive Sergei Khudoleyev said on Monday.
He said the EBRD had bought the stake from Finnish brewer Oy Sinebrychoff AB, which had owned more than 99 percent of Vyena's shares. He did not reveal the price.
AO Vyena was privatised in 1992. Sinebrychoff won an investment tender for 37.5 percent of the shares in 1993 and bought the rest from small shareholders.
The Finnish company was obliged to invest 56 million markka but had already put in more than this, Khudoleyev said.
He said talks among the main shareholders were under way on further investment to raise output.

Vyena produces beer and, by agreement with Pepsico Inc, also makes Pepsi-Cola. Total output was 15 million litres in the first eight months of this year, against 9.5 million in the correpsonding period of 1995.
